title: Surface and Material Inspection Software — Overview and definition
t: Surface and Material Inspection Software — Overview and definition
description: Quantifies surface finish, coating, and material defects from sensor data.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Quantifies surface finish, coating, and material defects from sensor data. Surface and material inspection software analyzes profilometer traces, interferometry maps, and camera images to report roughness (Ra, Rz), flatness, coating thickness, and defect maps. Real implementations include MountainsMap, Gwyddion, and vendor packages for white-light interferometers. It applies ISO 4287/25178 filters, stitches fields of view, and trends measurements for process control.
capabilities: Roughness, waviness, and areal texture parameters per ISO standards
Defect segmentation: pits, scratches, inclusions, delamination
Coating thickness from eddy-current, ultrasonic, or XRF gauges
Field stitching for large-area surface maps
SPC trending of surface parameters

Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Roughness, waviness, and areal texture parameters per ISO standards). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Roughness, waviness, and areal texture parameters per ISO standards and Defect segmentation: pits, scratches, inclusions, delamination. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Image recognition and inspection tool) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
